# What You Already Know

<!-- STEP id="what-citizens-do" -->
## What Citizens Do

You have met this in earlier grades. In a democracy, citizens have the right to vote, to express their opinions and to take part in making decisions. Tap each one to see an example.

<!-- STEP id="what-it-rests-on" -->
## What Democracy Rests On

Democracy is founded on the principles of **freedom, equality, justice, and rights and duties**. A vote means little if people are not free to speak or are not treated as equals.

**An election is one part of a democracy. These principles must hold along with it.**
